name: Letter Jam
summary: Cooperative deduction where each player sees others' letters but not their own and gives clues to help everyone guess a hidden word.
rules_text: Each player receives a shuffled 5-letter secret word they may never look at, keeping one letter face out to others in a stand. A draw deck and clue tokens limit the game, with nonplayer stands added to always show five letters. Each round players openly discuss which of them can form the best word from the visible letters and choose a cluegiver. The cluegiver marks their word's order with numbered tokens placed on the stands, using the wildcard as a single unspecified letter if desired, without naming private letters. Anyone whose letter was used writes the pattern with a ? for their unknown, notes possible letters, and may lock in a guess face down and advance to their next secret letter. Used nonplayer letters are discarded and replaced from their stack, revealing extra clue tokens when stacks empty. After original letters, extra cards become guessable bonus letters. Play ends when clue tokens are exhausted or all words are guessed; remaining letters are unscrambled to reveal each word and bonus letters help complete final words.
rating_reason: Hidden letter, cooperative deduction, fully text playable
